sound.bgMusicDesc: Upload your own track, plays on loop (starts after the first click)

focus.toggle: Focus mode (hide everything except clock + search)

mostVisited.permissionNeeded: Permission to read most-visited sites is required

dailyQuote.autoHideDesc: Turn off to keep it until you press ✕

qr.empty: Enter content to generate a QR code

bgfx.effectDesc: A transparent overlay above the wallpaper/video

settings.title: Settings
settings.panelBlurDesc: How much the background behind sidebars/windows is blurred (frosted glass)
settings.lowPowerDesc: Reduce animations, disable background effects and video wallpapers
settings.lowPowerSuggest: Your system prefers reduced motion. Enable low-power mode?
settings.sidebarModeDesc: Open one panel at a time, or allow multiple panels open together
settings.sidebarWidthDesc: Width of the left sidebar panel (you can also drag its right edge)
settings.bgDimDesc: Darken the overlay on the wallpaper for better readability
settings.panelAlphaDesc: Lower values make sidebars and windows more see-through (glass effect)
settings.parallaxDesc: Wallpaper shifts slightly with the cursor (auto-off in low-power mode)
settings.importConfirm: Importing will overwrite overlapping current data. Continue?
settings.importNewer: This backup was created by a newer version — cannot import.
settings.importDone: Backup imported. Reload the page to apply.

notifications.title: Notifications
notifications.osPermission: Grant system notification permission to get reminders when the tab is closed

github.tokenDesc: Create a PAT at github.com/settings/tokens (scopes: read:user, notifications). Stored locally, never sent elsewhere.
github.notConnected: Not connected — enter a Personal Access Token in Settings
github.showTrendingDesc: Add a trending repos section (day/week/month) at the bottom
github.error: Could not load GitHub data — check your token

spotify.clientIdDesc: Register an app at developer.spotify.com, add the Redirect URI shown below, then paste the Client ID here.
spotify.redirectUri: Redirect URI (add to your Spotify app)
spotify.premiumNote: Playback control requires a Premium account

calendar.useGoogleDesc: Optional: pull events & upcoming schedule from your Google Calendar
calendar.clientIdDesc: Create an OAuth Client (Web) in Google Cloud Console, add the Redirect URI below, enable Calendar API, then paste the Client ID.

news.chooseFeedsDesc: A built-in list of supported feeds (keeps load light)
news.chooseTopicsDesc: Mix news from several sources by the topics you pick
news.translateEndpointDesc: Enter a LibreTranslate URL to enable quick-translate; leave empty to hide the button
news.permissionNeeded: Network access is needed to fetch RSS from news sources
news.noTopics: No topics selected — open Settings to choose
news.error: Could not load news — try again later

avatar.empty: No avatar yet — upload an image or GIF to show it on the main area

search.customUrlDesc: Use %s as the query placeholder, e.g. https://example.com/search?q=%s

clock.customHint: Set the clock style to "Custom (CSS)" above to edit presets.
clock.noPreset: No preset yet — press + to create one
clock.cssHint: CSS applies only to the clock (Shadow DOM sandbox). Classes: .cc, .cc-time, .cc-h, .cc-m, .cc-s, .cc-c, .cc-date.

wallpaper.empty: No wallpapers yet — using the theme's default gradient
wallpaper.videoWarn: Large videos consume storage and battery. Save anyway?
wallpaper.loadUrlError: Could not load image from this URL
wallpaper.randomModeDesc: Pick a random wallpaper from the library each time a new tab opens
wallpaper.storageNote: Images/videos are stored right in your browser (IndexedDB) — no data loss when you shut down.
wallpaper.disabledByLowPower: Video wallpaper is off due to low-power mode
wallpaper.pauseWhenHidden: Play only on the New Tab
wallpaper.pauseWhenHiddenDesc: Pauses the video (and sound) when you switch to another tab — saves CPU and battery

bookmarks.permissionNeeded: Permission to read browser bookmarks is required
bookmarks.firstTimeNote: Tip: hide the browser's native bookmark bar (Ctrl+Shift+B) to avoid visual duplication.

onboarding.welcomeBody: A quick 1-minute setup — pick a theme, wallpaper and weather location.
onboarding.stepThemeDesc: Applied instantly; you can change it later in Settings.
onboarding.stepWallpaperDesc: Use the theme gradient or upload your own image.
onboarding.stepWeatherDesc: Enter a city or use your current location. Skip to keep clock only.
onboarding.stepBookmarksDesc: Show your browser bookmarks right on the NewTab?
onboarding.stepFeaturesDesc: Quickly turn on the panels/tools you want from the start. You can change these later in Settings.
onboarding.doneBody: Everything can be adjusted in Settings (bottom-right corner).
